arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Taibleson argued that Congress intended to punish dangerous felons who use guns during violent crimes.
Mr. Dreeben argued that an attempt to commit Hobbs Act robbery is not a crime of violence.
Mr. Dreeben stated that the categorical approach focuses on the minimum conduct prohibited by the statute.
Ms. Taibleson noted that the phrase threaten force appears in both the Hobbs Act and the sentencing statute.
